Run both versions on a graph with a few hundred vertices and edges (e.g., a dense random graph). data.trace_question: What is the observed difference in execution time for the membership checks when using a list versus a set on the same input? Does the list version become noticeably slower as the graph grows?
data.expected_insight: The student will see that membership testing in a list grows linearly with the size of `visited`, making the algorithm much slower, while using a set keeps membership checks constant‑time, confirming that list membership is not O(1).
